TASK-034: fixed 5 CLI bugs found by TASK-033 audit.
- Bug1 config --set: made option repeatable (collect fn, default []); added pure static parseConfigSet() with whitelist+type validation (string defaultUsername; booleans; int maxDependencyDepth 1-20; nested rateLimiting.* numeric>0 / backoffStrategy enum / enableAdaptiveThrottling bool; customFields.<name> arbitrary). accessToken/githubToken rejected via --set with --token/--github-token hint. handleConfigCommand deep-merges rateLimiting/customFields from loaded config (avoids saveConfig shallow overwrite), prints masked applied pairs.
- Bug2 status directory mode: -d/--directory (default CWD) + --recursive. Refactored findMarkdownFiles(dir, recursive=true) — reused by reset (unchanged) and status; skips dot-dirs/node_modules/dist. New computeFileStatus() wraps MetadataManager (same path as -f branch). Per-file line + status-count summary. Single-file -f branch unchanged.
- Bug3 svg --margin: EnhancedCommands passes margin ?? 3 (parity with pdf ?? 15); SvgGenerator internal fallback 5→3.
- Bug4 svg -o help: corrected to '<input-basename>.svg next to the input file'.
- Bug5 cli.ts:250: removed placeholder github URL, replaced with 'See README.md for more information'.

- src/cli/EnhancedCommands.ts: --set repeatable option; parseConfigSet/parseBooleanValue/maskSensitive/describeConfigSetKeys; handleConfigCommand rewrite; handleStatusCommand directory mode + computeFileStatus + statusIcon; findMarkdownFiles(recursive) refactor; import relative.
- src/svg/SvgGenerator.ts: margin fallback 5→3.
- src/cli.ts: help-examples placeholder URL removed.
- src/cli/EnhancedCommands.cli-fixes.test.ts: NEW bun:test file, 19 tests (config --set validation + directory-status helpers).

- parseConfigSet kept PURE (no fs) for direct unit-testing; IO/deep-merge lives in handleConfigCommand. Rationale: rateLimiting.* must merge into existing config object or ConfigManager.saveConfig's shallow spread would drop sibling rate fields.
- findMarkdownFiles gained recursive param (default true) instead of a copy — reset behavior byte-identical, status reuses it.
- DST-debt (CD-63): status/config are NOT under DstIO. DstIO injection exists only in DependencyManager; EnhancedCommands CLI handlers are static methods using node:fs directly with no IO seam. Wiring DstIO through the static command surface is a non-trivial refactor out of scope for a T2 bugfix. Per task instruction, NOT refactored; recorded as DST-debt. Directory traversal + status resolution tested against real temp dirs instead.
- Full bun test suite has ~51 PRE-EXISTING failures (TOC/anchors/markdownConverter/vitest-under-bun config-integration mocks) confirmed present at HEAD via clean worktree baseline (identical 9pass/5fail on EnhancedCommands.integration.test.ts). My changes add ZERO new failures; scoped tests (SvgGenerator 5/5, cli-fixes 19/19) all green.

Исполнитель: mb3-implementer (opus), оркестраторская верификация выполнена.

Правки:
- src/cli/EnhancedCommands.ts (+319): (1) config --set — повторяемая опция + parseConfigSet с whitelist-валидацией (строки/булевы/int 1-20/rateLimiting.*/customFields.*; отказ для accessToken/githubToken), глубокий merge rateLimiting/customFields, маскировка в выводе; (2) status -d/--recursive — findMarkdownFiles параметризован recursive (переиспользован из reset), computeFileStatus через MetadataManager, построчный вывод + сводка; (3) svg margin ?? 3.
- src/svg/SvgGenerator.ts: внутренний fallback margin 5→3.
- src/cli.ts: placeholder GitHub URL → «See README.md».
- src/cli/EnhancedCommands.cli-fixes.test.ts (новый): 19 тестов.

UR Coverage:
- UR-001 (superseded by UR-002) / UR-002 (5 багов): ВСЕ 5 исправлены — пункты 1-5 выше.
- UR-003 (config --set реализовать с валидацией): ВЫПОЛНЕН — generic setter + 19 тестов на типы/ключи/диапазоны/токены.
- UR-004 (status directory-режим): ВЫПОЛНЕН — обход + сводка + тесты recursive/non-recursive/node_modules.

CD-63 DST-debt (зафиксировано): DstIO внедрён только в DependencyManager; статические CLI-хендлеры EnhancedCommands без IO-шва — проброс DstIO = нетривиальный рефакторинг вне рамок T2; покрыто тестами на реальных tmp-каталогах. Кандидат в dst-phase-3 (TASK-004 в memory-bank).
